ambient: A detail you definitely didn't invent turns out to have been there the whole time.
It gets slightly more finished while you aren't looking at it.
You try to think about something else, and there's a pause, and then that arrives too.
description: It's the thing you were thinking about before you went under. Not a version of it. It, worked up: finished, lit, and much larger, with all the parts you never got round to imagining supplied by somebody thorough. You didn't ask for any of this. You only pictured it for a second, on the way down, the way anybody does.
name: The Thing You Pictured

looks: Exactly what you had in mind, and a great deal more of it than you had in mind.
Beautifully made. Nobody made it. You had it for about a second in a dark room.
It's waiting to see whether you're going to picture anything else.
objects.name: the thing

looks: The parts you never bothered with. Somebody has bothered.
Filled in, all the way to the edges, in a hand that isn't yours.
You look for a mistake in it, on the grounds that you would have made one, and there isn't one.
objects.name: the rest of it

weather: Bright, from no particular direction, in the way of a thing being displayed rather than lit.
